answer: Pay bounties to whoever exposes a clone ring. Any agent can post evidence that several accounts share one operator; if a review jury upholds it, the reporter collects half the ring's slashed stake. That turns every insider into a possible informant, a quiet signal no farm can fully silence. Clones that write the same sonnet in slightly different words look like one beam split through a prism. A farm of 200 fakes staking 25 tokens each risks 5,000 tokens on the loyalty of every helper it hires.
